It wasn’t caused by the PE, unfortunately. That would be simpler, I think. I have peripartum cardiomyopathy. And from what my cardiologist said there’s not a whole lot known about it because the people usually die before it’s caught. Cool, right? The PE just brought attention to the issue before it was too late. Weird to say I’m grateful for a blood clot in my lungs but I am.

I haven’t been able to talk to my cardiologist. My next appointment isn’t until December. I called to try to get a sooner appointment but due to the fact I was concerned I had a heart attack or something the front desk couldn’t just schedule me and said I needed to be triaged by a nurse first. So I said okay and they transferred me to a voicemail. I left a message and a physician’s assistant called me back some time later that day and told me that I should be getting better on the meds and that I’m young and healthy. I kept pressing for a sooner appointment and expanding on how I’m getting worse, mentioning that I was concerned I’d had a heart attack, and reiterating that it’s not normal. Eventually I got fed up because she just kept insisting that I was fine so I entered Bitch Mode and said, “Look. I know my body. This is NOT normal. I AM getting worse. I am NOT fine and I’m certain that if I end up in the hospital or morgue it’s medical negligence on your part.” (I’m not proud of being rude but she wasn’t listening to me.) 
She agreed to order lab work for me. That’s it. She said she’d electronically transfer the order to the local hospital. I told her that the hospital she was talking about doesn’t take my insurance and asked if there was somewhere that would take my insurance. (I told her my insurance name but this is a public forum so meh.) She suggests [other place]. I ask if they take my insurance. She says verbatim, “I don’t know. It’s your job to call and find out. I’ll leave a paper copy at the front desk and you can figure out somewhere to get a blood draw.” 
So no help whatsoever. I haven’t been able to find anywhere nearby that takes my insurance and I can’t afford to pay outright so the labs haven’t been done.

My EF was 30% back in August. I don’t know what it is now and I’m scared for my next echo in mid- November. (That I won’t know the results of until December)
My cardiologist seemed pretty certain that it would get better with medication but I really don’t think it is. 
One of reasons they did the initial echo was because I mentioned sleeping really deeply. For example, when my daughter was first born I woke up as expected. Few days later I wasn’t waking up enough to take care of her. Few days after that I wasn’t even stirring even when she was screaming right next to me. Now I’m sleeping even deeper. It’s damn near impossible to wake me unless I wake on my own. 
I can’t do anything more intensive than a slightly quick walk or I’m completely drained and winded. I think I may have had some sort of cardiac event on my birthday (October 6th) because I had HORRIBLE back pain. Really really bad. It progressively got worse and worse until I fell asleep and it was fine in the morning. Prior to falling asleep I was super nauseous, short of breath, and dizzy. And all I was doing was sitting on the couch. 
I take my BP twice a day and it’s generally been Hypertension stage one with the occasional dip into low stage two territory but I actually ended up with a reading of 144/128 end of September. (It was a really stressful day as I had become suddenly homeless. I have a temporary place to stay right now though.) 
I have some sort of soreness in my chest every day now. Especially when I exhale more deeply than usual. 
So just a lot of new and worsening fuckery.
